data.title: Unit 7: Heat, light, and sound
Temperature
data.rubric: Click on the water to see the temperature rise in the thermometers.
data.text: A thermometer is used for measuring temperature.
There are two main scales for measuring temperature: Celsius and Fahrenheit.
The third scale used for measuring temperature is the Kelvin scale.
The Kelvin scale is used for measuring extremely cold and extremely hot temperatures.
